rows.candidate_origin: R392 fresh full-universe diverse cluster / diverse rank 1
collapse_regions: uniform importance weights -> exact removal control
rows.evidence_boundary: deterministic synthetic mechanism evidence only; no empirical transportability, finance, deployment or novel-theory claim
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: same CAPL-style optimizer, rows, seed and constraints with uniform observation weights; P090 source-to-target weighting no longer changes the training objective

nearest_existing_products.difference: SACAPL changes covariance risk geometry inside CAPL; SWCAPL changes observation weights in the direct policy-learning objective.
REICAPL changes heterogeneous per-asset feasible caps; SWCAPL leaves feasible caps intact and changes observation weighting.
SWDL uses target weighting for predictive-model decision-loss selection; SWCAPL learns a constrained policy directly under target-weighted realized action performance.
CAPL uses the unweighted sample objective; SWCAPL applies externally justified source-to-target importance weights before constrained optimization.

rows.new_failure_mode: CAPL can optimize the wrong source-dominant policy when a declared source-to-target shift changes which observations should dominate the direct constrained action objective.
rows.non_additive_interaction: P090 externally supplied target importance weights and OWS support gate reweight CAPL realized-action training objective before constrained policy optimization, changing the learned policy rather than appending a transport diagnostic.
rows.sensitivity_boundary: conditional, not universal: target share .20/.35 gives 0/3 positive seeds, while .50/.65/.80 gives 3/3 positive seeds in the 15-run synthetic sweep
rows.support_boundary: importance weights are externally justified; OWS ESS diagnoses concentration only; fragile ESS fails closed and weights are not learned from outcomes inside this product
rows.working_region: declared target distribution is sufficiently shifted toward regime1 and supplied source-to-target weights are correct

rules: visibility expansion is not itself product promotion
executable suite does not imply distinct family
new failure + non-additive interaction + nearest-family comparison + mechanism-removal control required
mechanics telemetry calibrates executable contracts only
current test signature, not an older pilot signature, controls calibration authority
